risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The document states that 30% of revenues are in foreign currencies (60 currencies), which can significantly impact results. The language intensity is moderate, but the impact is substantial.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainties and client decision-making
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates the company navigated a year of macroeconomic uncertainty that slowed client decision-making. The language is direct and the context is a current concern.

risks.title: Dependence on strategic acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions having completed and continuing to consider strategic acquisitions to enhance its capabilities. The language is neutral, but reliance on these transactions for growth is implicit.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and responsible AI management
risks.score_rationale: The company commits to using AI responsibly, emphasizing privacy, regulatory compliance, and patient safety. The language is cautious, highlighting the importance of these aspects.

risks.title: Litigation-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The document refers to Note 12 for legal proceedings, indicating they are a component of financial reporting. The absence of specific details suggests a managed but present risk.

risks.title: Evolving work practices and real estate needs
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions assessing future workforce practices that may lead to changes in real estate requirements. The language is forward-looking and the risk appears manageable.

ai_positioning.summary: IQVIA explicitly commits to responsible AI use, with AI-powered capabilities embedded in its Connected Intelligence platform. The company emphasizes best practices in privacy, regulatory compliance, and patient safety, developing medical-grade AI solutions for the life sciences industry.
